# WC-0001: Architecture and Boundaries

**Status:** SUPERSEDED
**Program Increment:** PI-001

## Objective

Establish the first accepted architecture baseline needed to support implementation planning.

## Planned Work Packets

- WP-0001 — Architecture Baseline
- WP-0002 — Foundational ADR Bundle
- WP-0003 — Critical Quality Attributes

## Exit Conditions

- architecture is sufficiently unambiguous for downstream specification work;
- major system boundaries are explicit;
- foundational architectural decisions are recorded;
- critical quality attributes are documented; and
- open architecture questions no longer block implementation planning.
